description: This PHP class in the Opencart project's admin model handles operations related to customer groups, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving customer group data and descriptions. It interacts with the database directly and references other models for related data management.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Model class for managing customer group entities within the Opencart admin module, including CRUD operations and related descriptions.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Creates a new customer group record in the database and adds associated descriptions.

methods.name: editCustomerGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing customer group record and its descriptions in the database.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroup
methods.description: Deletes a customer group and its related data, including discounts, rewards, and tax rate associations.

methods.name: getCustomerGroup
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific customer group by ID.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer groups, possibly filtered and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer groups.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a customer group for a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a customer group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all customer group descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific description for a customer group in a given language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a customer group.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all customer group descriptions for a specific language.
